name: superb
description: Personal product-discovery, implementation-pipeline and bug-fix skills for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Clarify product ideas, run an implementation pipeline, fix bugs from evidence.
interface.longDescription: Craft turns a vague product idea into a decision-rich brief. Pipeline takes an approved brief through planning, implementation, review, and fixes. Bug-fix traces a reported bug to file:line evidence before any fix is planned, and is not done until a regression test that failed first passes.
defaultPrompt: Help me turn this product idea into a clear brief.
Run the implementation pipeline for this approved design.
Find out why this is broken and fix it.
